arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 8 km, 6.4 legs of 1250 m. CP boat 130 W / pod 194 W, may be 10-25% off. Hard start; settle near CP by min 2-3, then pace so reserve reaches ~0 at finish. Leg 1 current against (push_along -0.12). Watch pod vs boat reserve for disagreement (current/drag/fouled rudder). Finish sprint last ~400-600 m.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course current estimate; strongly negative = extra drag (weed on rudder, damage) not current

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power explains, beyond current: check rudder/drag

text: cued ease to 159 s/500 ground: power crept back above critical power with the reserve near empty

Right after turn push_local was -0.14 on a helping leg (turn lag?); added watch slow_on_helping_leg to catch a fouled rudder.

Plan by pod: tailwind legs (4, 6, 8) shaft ~180-185 to refill; headwind legs (5 from 5000 m, 7 from 7500 m) shaft ~200-205; finish push last ~500 m on leg 8 (tailwind). Ground pace targets mislead in wind: prefer push/hold without pace, or recompute per leg.

Removed drag_jump (wind trips it), added drag_extreme (< -0.8). After push cue shaft 207 W (CP 194), pod reserve 19%: push fades; want ~200-203 avg on this leg. If over_on_empty fires, ease. Weed check on leg 6: slow_on_helping_leg.

text: no cue: the drag alert is the headwind (step at the turn, no mid-leg jump, paddler reports no boat problem); the push is working and will fade toward critical power; swapped in a stricter drag watch

arguments.text: Clear the rudder now. One back-stroke, then straight back on.

26.0 min: paddler says boat suddenly heavy, something on rudder? push_local -0.52 flat since the turn (could be wind or weed caught at the turn). Cued clear_rudder (cheap insurance vs ~0.1-0.3 m/s for 4 km). Check: if push_local rises clearly (e.g. to -0.3 or better) within a minute after, it was weed; if unchanged, it was wind. Pod reserve 18%, shaft 212.

arguments.text: Rudder is clear, it is the wind. Ease back, smooth.

27.2 min: after clear_rudder push_local unchanged (-0.525) and speed rose only as power did: heavy feel = headwind, not weed (confirm on leg 6 via slow_on_helping_leg). But shaft spiked to 235 W (CP 194), pod reserve 18% -> 4% in a minute. Cued ease (no pace). Target shaft ~195-200 for rest of leg 5, then ~185-190 on tailwind leg 6 to refill, ~200 leg 7, finish from ~9000 m.

text: cued ease: clearing the rudder changed nothing (it is the headwind), and the paddler spiked to 235 W shaft with the pod reserve at 4%
